title: Knowing and Eating
label: ch:ar-knowing-and-eating
canDo: I can say the Arabic for 'he knew' and 'he ate', tell ʿarafa apart from ʿalima, and say plainly which of these verbs has an English cousin and which has none.

payoff.summary: Say akala with no new letters left to learn, run its doer and done-to forms, place it beside Hebrew akhal, and restate the ʿarafa root family and its Spanish loan.
